scope: Actual decoded GLBs played by a fresh AnimationMixer with NO runtime IK modifying the baked root. Ghost runtime clone provides declared contact/support windows only; sphere centre/visibility come from the baked MotionBallAnchor. Actual Three.js skinned/morphed vertices, not virtual IK palm markers. Foot-dominant vertices sampled for all actions; all vertices additionally sampled for fall. Hand-dominant vertices sampled only during declared full contact. This measures vertices, not continuous triangle/ball collision or physical simulation.
